task: A recommended PostgreSQL index set for the query workload, with exact CREATE INDEX statements, the queries each serves, and space estimates.

criteria.text: Q1: a composite B-tree index on (user_id, created_at), with DESC or a note that a backward index scan serves ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50.
Q2: a partial index on (event_type, created_at) WHERE processed = false (or equivalent), serving the filter and ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 100.
Q3: an index for the created_at range (a B-tree on created_at, possibly covering user_id, or a BRIN index if rows arrive in time order), with a reason.
Q4: a GIN index on payload (jsonb_path_ops or the default jsonb_ops) for the @> containment query.
Q5: served by the existing primary key; no new index.

The statements are valid PostgreSQL (CREATE INDEX [CONCURRENTLY] ... ON events ...), and space estimates are of the right order for 50 million rows (about 1-2 GB for a two-column B-tree; a partial index proportional to the unprocessed fraction; BRIN in kilobytes to megabytes; GIN depending on payload size).
